apps.localizedDescription: Run Windows games on iPhone and iPad with Steam, GOG and Epic Games support. BCD is a fork of Madeira. Requires iOS/iPadOS 18 or later, an A13 chip or newer, and JIT. This unofficial source links directly to upstream IPA releases.
